newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish GDP growth slowed to 3.2 pct in 1996 -SF.
newsitem.headline: Finnish GDP growth slowed to 3.2 pct in 1996 -SF.

text.p: Finnish gross domestic product growth slowed to 3.2 percent last year from 4.5 percent (revised from 4.4 pct) in 1995, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Thursday, adding the figures were preliminary.
Official Q4 and full-year 1996 GDP data will be released on March 21.
The nominal value of Finnish 1996 GDP was 569 billion markka, SF said.
Manufacturing industry production increased almost three percent in 1996. Households' real earnings rose 1.5 percent and nominal consumer spending rose 4.8 percent, SF said.
